contract.inputs: AnisoPoint/AnisoLinear XY sampling of shared writable or manually addressed images with maximum ratios 2, 4, 8 or 16; explicit gradients or fragment implicit derivatives. Explicit LOD/LZ remains isotropic.
contract.outputs: Typed-load filtering computes texel-space major/minor gradient lengths, bounds anisotropy by the sampler limit, derives LOD from major/ratio and samples ceil(ratio) evenly spaced locations along the major normalized gradient. Existing address modes, array-layer isolation, mip/resource clamps, comparison and nonzero-weight min/max reduction apply to every tap. Zero footprints use one centered tap; a zero minor with positive major uses the maximum ratio. Explicit unnormalized gradients are normalized separately from footprint calculation. Cube sampling preserves the pinned Vulkan lowering to 2D-array faces: XY minus one and layer face minus twice floor(face/8), with no filtering across faces. Sampler LOD bias applies to explicit LOD/LZ; manual and hardware samplers share SDK-asserted bias bounds, and instruction bias is bounded before LOD addition. Read-only anisotropy with non-linear XY or mip filters also uses manual loads; all-linear read-only anisotropy retains the native sampler.
contract.cache: Complete resolved sampler specialization captures both already-manual resources and new sampler states that require manual anisotropy/addressing. A prior hardware variant cannot conceal a later hardware-to-manual transition. Changed tap limits and lowering remain covered by executable fingerprint. No serialized metadata layout changes or extra resources are introduced.

contract.outputs: PageWatch TrackOwned preserves its exact fast paths and can transactionally acquire mixed protected/gap ranges. contract.ordering: Allocate replacement map nodes/vectors and validate every existing/gap interval before VirtualProtect. Buffer ownership uses this API; existing CPU fault resolution, actual backing commit, untrack and image rearming remain authoritative.
